descriptionHtml:
Step into elegance with dress. This sophisticated dress features a flattering round neckline and pleated A-line silhouette, offering comfort and style. Crafted from lightweight chiffon, it is perfect for wedding celebrations, formal, cocktail, guest, ensuring you look and feel graceful as a distinguished guest.

Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.

Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
